diagnostic_defaults.note: None fields retain pinned outcome-dependent calibration rules; general noise shape/rate 0 defaults are always overridden with the job proper prior.

model_spec.standardization_source: np.std(y, ddof=0) of the job panel

seed_schedule.note: unchanged from didbcf_structured/model.py; only the accepted budget, not the seed map, may change

earlier_budget_repaired.label: repaired engine at the earlier proper-prior budget

engine_specification.target_prior: raw depth/split/feature/uniform-node-range prior globally restricted and normalized on minleaf/maxdepth-feasible numeric trees

structured_chain.tau_key: every structured job: full (n_obs, num_mcmc) effect surface
structured_chain.completion: complete.json published last, with output checksums

pretrend_atomic.note: atomic recovery unit: BCFModel per-chain state is not serialised, so an interrupted job restarts from its seed and is never appended to

output_schema.assembly: the collector concatenates chains in chain_index order, computes multi-chain diagnostics on the assembled draws and recomputes finite-sample truths from the regenerated panel

resource_estimate_note: Pilot measurements when strata match; historical timing proxies elsewhere. Inspect free disk before each wave.
